Vedanta Aluminium Secures ₹13,500 Crore Loan Post-Demerger

Vedanta Aluminium has raised a loan of ₹13,500 crore following the demerger of the Vedanta Group. The move involves billionaire Anil Agarwal's business. The specific purpose of the loan was not detailed in the coverage, but it follows a significant restructuring of the group's operations.
